children: Shares of fuel-cell and power technology company Bloom Energy Corp. (BE, Financials), down sharply following a better-than-expected third quarter.
Adjusted earnings were $0.94 a share, above the average forecast of $0.69. Revenue was $1.24 billion, above the expected $1.06 billion.
The company now expects full-year 2026 earnings per share of $3.10 to $3.40 and revenue of $4.4 billion to $4.6 billion. These measures are indicative of good operational performance.
But the market's reaction is an altogether other story. Bloom shares dropped over 12% despite a beat on earnings and a brighter outlook.
The stock doubled over the past year, and expectations were already running considerably ahead of reported levels. The main question for investors is: value?
Strong profit growth is not enough if the market has already priced in an aggressive AI-power demand scenario.
Another thing to watch is if Bloom can sustain enough sales growth and margin expansion to justify those ambitious forecasts.

title: Bloom Energy Beats Earnings, but Shares Still Tumble
